CodeLensEnabled.description: A flag which indicates whether code metrics are shown as code lens

CodeLensHiddenUnder.description: Threshold to show code lens for code metrics

ComplexityColorExtreme.description: Color for the extreme complexity level

ComplexityColorHigh.description: Color for the high complexity level

ComplexityColorLow.description: Color for the low complexity level

ComplexityColorNormal.description: Color for the normal complexity level

ComplexityLevelExtreme.description: Threshold to determine extreme high complexity level

ComplexityLevelExtremeDescription.description: Code lens message for extreme high complexity level

ComplexityLevelHigh.description: Threshold to determine high complexity level

ComplexityLevelHighDescription.description: Code lens message for high complexity level

ComplexityLevelLow.description: Threshold to determine low complexity level

ComplexityLevelLowDescription.description: Code lens message for low complexity level

ComplexityLevelNormal.description: Threshold to determine normal complexity level

ComplexityLevelNormalDescription.description: Code lens message for normal complexity level

ComplexityTemplate.description: Code lens message template {0} stands for the actual value {1} is for the complexity level description

DecorationModeEnabled.description: A flag which indicates whether code metrics are shown as inline decoration

DecorationTemplate.default: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='{{size}}px' height='{{size}}px' viewbox='0 0 {{size}} {{size}}'><rect width='{{size}}' height='{{size}}' style='fill:{{color}};stroke-width:1;stroke:#fff'/></svg>
DecorationTemplate.description: A flag which indicates whether code metrics are shown as inline decoration

DiagnosticsEnabled.description: A flag which indicates whether code metrics are shown as diagnostics

Exclude.description: Array of exclusion patterns (in glob format)

FileSizeLimitMB.description: File size limit in megabytes, above this codemetrics are not going to be computed, use a negative number to allow any size

IgnoredFunctionNames.description: A set of function names to ignore from calculations

MetricsForArrowFunctionsToggled.description: A flag which indicates whether code metrics are enabled for arrow functions (can also be toggled via a command)

MetricsForClassDeclarationsToggled.description: A flag which indicates whether code metrics are enabled for class declarations

MetricsForConstructorsToggled.description: A flag which indicates whether code metrics are enabled for constructors

MetricsForEnumDeclarationsToggled.description: A flag which indicates whether code metrics are enabled for enum declarations

MetricsForFunctionDeclarationsToggled.description: A flag which indicates whether code metrics are enabled for function declarations

MetricsForFunctionExpressionsToggled.description: A flag which indicates whether code metrics are enabled for function expressions

MetricsForMethodDeclarationsToggled.description: A flag which indicates whether code metrics are enabled for methods declarations

OverviewRulerModeEnabled.description: A flag which indicates whether code metrics are shown on the overview ruler
